items.name: Paneer Tikka
items.description: Grilled Indian cottage cheese cubes marinated overnight in yogurt, turmeric, and a bold blend of tandoori spices. Smoky, satisfying, with a charred edge.

items.name: Crispy Calamari
items.description: Lightly battered squid rings fried to a golden crisp, served with a house-made lemon aioli and a side of marinara. Light, airy, and addictive.

items.name: Spicy Chicken Sandwich
items.description: Buttermilk-brined fried chicken breast coated in a cayenne-honey glaze, stacked on a brioche bun with house pickles, shredded slaw, and chipotle mayo.

items.name: Grilled Atlantic Salmon
items.description: Wild-caught Atlantic salmon fillet grilled over hardwood, finished with a citrus-dill butter sauce and served alongside seasonal roasted vegetables and herb rice.

items.name: Wild Mushroom Risotto
items.description: Slow-cooked arborio rice with a medley of foraged wild mushrooms, shallots, white wine, and finished with aged parmesan and truffle oil. Rich, earthy, deeply comforting.

items.name: Veggie Jalapeño Wrap
items.description: A whole-wheat wrap packed with roasted bell peppers, black beans, pickled jalapeños, avocado, and a smoky chipotle hummus. Bright, punchy, and filling.

items.name: Truffle Parmesan Fries
items.description: Crispy hand-cut fries tossed in truffle oil, flaky sea salt, fresh rosemary, and a generous snowfall of aged parmesan. Decadent yet effortless.

items.name: Garlic Butter Naan
items.description: Pillowy tandoor-baked flatbread brushed generously with roasted garlic butter and fresh coriander. Pairs perfectly with anything saucy.

items.name: Caesar Salad
items.description: Classic romaine lettuce with house-made Caesar dressing, shaved parmesan, house-baked croutons, and a squeeze of fresh lemon. Crisp, tangy, timeless.

items.name: Mango Lassi
items.description: Chilled blended drink made with fresh Alphonso mango pulp, creamy yogurt, a pinch of cardamom, and a drizzle of rose water. Cooling, sweet, and fragrant.

items.name: House Lemonade
items.description: Freshly squeezed lemonade with a hint of mint and elderflower syrup over crushed ice. Refreshing, light, and slightly floral.

items.name: Sparkling Water
items.description: Chilled San Pellegrino sparkling mineral water. Clean, crisp, and pairs with everything.
